acceptanceCriteria: The owner decides how a repository whose governing intent is ADRs and roadmap tickets (no `## Requirements` spec) enters the daily adopter path, and the decision is recorded.

One real Beamfall change completes `corvint dogfood change/check/seal` with the installed binary without adding a Corvint-format spec to Beamfall only to satisfy the tool, or the decision records why that is acceptable under invariant 6.
body: Found 2026-09-25 while attempting V1-0184. `git grep -c '^## Requirements'` finds nothing in Beamfall core (3252 tracked files at 2a8e06b2) or anywhere in beamfall-workspace. Beamfall states intent in ADRs (`## Decisions` with `### N.` items, e.g. docs/adr ADR-0224) and roadmap tickets (`**Acceptance:**`/`**Do:**`/`**Verify:**` blocks in docs/plans/roadmap/*.md). The daily adopter path requires DOGFOOD_INTENTS_FILE entries with exactly one `## Requirements` heading (OCM-V0-001, internal/lrfrepo/ocm.go:556 `invalid-requirements-section`; docs/DOGFOOD.md Inputs table), so no Beamfall change can reach `complete: true` and V1-0184 cannot produce `beamfall-dogfood` receipts. This is in tension with AGENTS.md invariant 6 (integrate with existing specs; no new spec language). Routes: (a) add a Beamfall requirements spec first, then change against it; (b) extend OCM intent reading to a repository-declared form (ADR decisions or roadmap acceptance blocks) under its own spec; (c) allow an intent-free daily path whose OCM rows are NOT_PRODUCED but still complete for the three Core use cases. Owner decision.
title: dogfood: the daily path requires a `## Requirements` intent spec, which Beamfall does not have, so V1-0184 cannot run
